_meta.method: Fuzzy scoring was used only to generate candidates. Every accepted match was confirmed by scientific name and by the plant organ, then written by hand. Name similarity alone was never sufficient — the rejected USDA analogue matcher scored Edible lime (calcium hydroxide) at 1.00 against Lime, raw, and this run's fuzzy pass scored Bathua at 0.90 against Milk, whole, Cow.
_meta.rule: Accept only when species and organ agree. A different species, a different plant part, or a processed form of a raw row is a rejection, not a near match.

accept_with_note.why: Solanum melongena. IFCT publishes eight numbered cultivars plus an explicit all-varieties aggregate. We hold no cultivar-specific row for long purple, so the published aggregate is the honest source rather than picking one of the eight arbitrarily.
accept_with_note.note: Record as the aggregate, not as a cultivar measurement.

accept_with_note.why: Punica granatum. IFCT carries a single pomegranate row and it is the sweet table form.
accept_with_note.note: dravya.pomegranate-sour must NOT take this row — sourness is the defining difference and no sour row exists.

accept_with_note.why: Trichosanthes anguina, same organ. IFCT splits by length and shade; the dravya is generic, and long pale green is the common market form.
accept_with_note.note: Cultivar-level approximation within one species. Flag for the vaidya if cultivar matters.

Garcinia gummi-gutta against Pithecellobium dulce. Unrelated.
Momordica dioica against Momordica charantia. Different species; kantola is not bitter gourd.
Nymphaea stem against Nelumbium root. Different genus and different organ.
Dioscorea alata against Dioscorea versicolor. Different species; wild yam is not kand.

Triticum dicoccum against Triticum aestivum. Khapli is a different wheat species.
Vanpayar is Vigna unguiculata; IFCT's rows are Vigna catjang and neither is red.
Papdi is Lablab purpureus; IFCT's tender field beans are Vicia faba. Different genus.

Tender pod against leaf. Different organ.

Curcuma caesia against Curcuma longa. Kali haldi is not turmeric.
Kakri is Cucumis melo var. utilissimus; IFCT's cucumbers are Cucumis sativus.
Cashew apple against cashew nut. Different organ entirely.

Capparis decidua. IFCT has no Capparis row.
Buchanania lanzan seed. The score came from 'charoli' resembling 'cholai'. IFCT has no Buchanania row.
